name: Hut 8 Corp
verdict: FLAT — named kill: DATA-INTEGRITY (Item-8.01 unreadable lease). The load-bearing contract — a $9.8B/15yr NNN lease, 74% of contracted MW — was disclosed under Item 8.01 'Other Events', never filed as an exhibit; termination-for-convenience, conditions precedent and outside-delivery-date rights are UNREADABLE from any venue (FTK precedent: unverifiable load-bearing terms = data-integrity class). Secondary ground: corrected funded prize (incl. 17,316 BTC less encumbrance) = ~$95/sh at coupon-as-cap vs $80.86 tape — +50% not cleared at any cap >=5.5% even granting perfect execution.
conviction: red 8/10 REJECT (mechanism corrected by blue), blue 8/10 FLAT — convergent
kill_class_census: 4 NOVEL (unreadable lease; 46% of BTC encumbered — 7,940 of 17,316 pledged; funded-prize-at-tape; BTC-beta drawdown attribution) / 2 CONSENSUS (op EBITDA ~$42M ann. vs $9.97B cap; unrestricted cash $233.6M = 2.3% of cap)
audit_notes: Blue overturned red's furnished-vs-filed claim (the 7/20 8-K is Item 8.01 incorporated-by-reference, i.e. FILED — but with NO lease exhibit, which is the sharper finding); blue struck red's coupon-as-cap-rate mechanism as a units error while confirming the table roughly right (two errors cancel); red's kg coupon_as_cap_rate_prize_floor REJECTED for KG as stated.
recourt_triggers: lease FILED with termination/outside-date terms (10-K or Item 1.01 amendment)
tape < ~$60 (8% cap on corrected prize clears +50% with margin)

narratives: Tripwire-less (unknown-unknown: private-contract terms) — the unreadable lease turns out to be bulletproof hell-or-high-water paper, a tenant is named (hyperscaler), and the stock re-rates to the street's 5-5.5% cap without our ever getting the disclosure our re-court gate demands.
Ph2 financing prints tight and the market reads it as validation despite adding $4.25B ahead of equity — momentum re-crowds the name.
Reflexive: our FLAT is calendar-free; nothing forces a revisit before the 10-K, so a mid-quarter tenant reveal passes unsensed (mitigated: 8-K event gate armed).
premortem.sentence: If this ruling costs us, the most likely reason will be that the lease we could not read was fine all along — the disclosure gap resolves bullish and the re-rate happens before any document we gated on ever gets filed.
